visualCharacteristics: Carousel of recent lottery winners. Each slide shows a winner photo, name, location, game logo, Winner badge, and formatted prize amount. 4 slides with navigation.
contentPattern: Each row is one slide. Column 1: winner photo. Column 2: winner name, location, game logo, badge text, and prize amount.
usage: Use for showcasing lottery or contest winners in a rotating carousel format.
reuseGuidance: Each slide row should have a winner photo in the first cell and winner details (name, location, prize) in the second cell.
